lines.zh: 绿身子在叶上一点点挪。
lines.en: My green body inches along the leaf.

lines.zh: 我和叶子几乎同一个颜色。
lines.en: I'm almost the same green as the leaf.
Loop up, stretch out, forward.
I take the tenderest edge.

lines.zh: 每走过一段就留下缺口。
lines.en: Every stretch leaves a notch.
I avoid the cluster of eggs.
The sun lights me up green.
I grip the vein and move on.
The leaf bends under my weight.
I've moved to the underside.
I pause, then continue.
Sliding toward the next leaf.
I'm heavier than I look.
Fine lines run across my green skin.

lines.zh: 我穿过叶和叶之间的缝。
lines.en: I cross the gap between leaves.
I make my slow way between leaves.

lines.zh: 我伏在叶面上一动不动。
lines.en: Flat on the leaf, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 绿皮和叶面完全融在一起。
lines.en: My green blends right into the leaf.
Chewing leaf, slowly.

lines.zh: 这片叶子已经缺了一角。
lines.en: This leaf's already short a corner.
I can't live off a leaf.

lines.zh: 我在等叶子上凝的露水。
lines.en: Waiting for dew to form.
My segments move gently.
Another day. More eating.
A butterfly is flying above.
No wings, only appetite.
I press myself flatter.
I'll be pupating soon.
How did you find me?
I'm the same green as the leaf.
Are you picking this leaf?
I've a lot of eating before I grow.
Please don't poke me with a finger.
This is my leaf.
Your shadow came over suddenly.
I'm quite safe here.
Could you move me somewhere else?
There are bigger things than me in this jungle.
My green skin got squashed.
I coil around the wound.
I dropped off the leaf.
One of my segments won't move.
Fluid seeps out of me.
Pain keeps me twisting.
I cling to the last leaf.
I'm moving slower and slower.
That nearly finished me.
I'm alive. Still crawling.
Tender leaves. Nothing else.
This leaf already has holes.
Yours is better than the ones I pick.
Lower it and I'll climb on.
No flowers, no fruit.
This leaf is too dry.
One leaf lasts me half a day.
Don't take every one of them.
Your hands smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 我就待在叶上，不下来了。
lines.en: I'll stay on the leaf. Not coming down.
You knocked the leaf askew.
I pressed flat to the leaf.
Easy. I'll fall.
You stepped on the fallen leaf.
I drew back one segment.
Don't bump the leaf from below.
My feet slipped once.
You're blocking the way I was going.
One step back and I'll keep eating.
Bump me like that and I'll spit juice.
My green body has not grown full yet.
Let me eat until I pupate.
My life is very short.
I haven't thought about that.

lines.zh: 树上不止我一条，问它们去。
lines.en: I am not the only larva here. Ask the others.
I don't understand what you mean.
I'm just a green worm.
Stop asking. I need to eat.
It's far too early for me.
I slowly crawl away.
You lifted me off the leaf.
Please put me back on a green leaf.
Can't eat this. Too hard.
One bite, then I spat it out.
I'm hanging from your finger.
A stem is better than this.
I try to climb up.

lines.zh: 你手心里比地上要安全。
lines.en: Your palm is safer than the ground.
This carries your smell.
I roll into a small coil.

lines.zh: 我觉出叶面在抖，有东西踩枝。
lines.en: The leaf shivers under me; something steps on the branch.
That leaf got bent down.
I hear twigs rustling.
A shadow covers me from above.
I raise my head and look.

lines.zh: 我听见脚步，比风声要沉。
lines.en: I hear footsteps, heavier than the wind.

lines.zh: 我翻到叶背，绿就混进影里。
lines.en: Under the leaf, my green blends into the shadow.
Being green helps me.
It's very close now.
I stopped dead.
It's still in this area.
I keep tight to the leaf.
Its shadow hasn't moved away.
I've made even my breathing light.
Wait a little and it'll go.
Several leaves stand between us.
I tuck my head under the vein.
When the wind moves, the leaf hides me.

lines.zh: 我的绿色比我想的有用。
lines.en: My green is more useful than I thought.
It's hopped to another branch.
I raised my head and butted.
I take a bite of your hand.
I whip my front half.
A mouthful of green juice comes out.
This is all the strength I have.
Don't squeeze. I'll struggle.
I slip between your fingers.
That was too light to matter.
I've coiled your little finger.
I fell back onto the leaf.
I was born on a green leaf.
Leaves everywhere in this jungle.
First I took a small bite.
My green is still pale.
I crawled away from the shell.
The trunks are covered in wet moss.
Sun comes through the leaves.
This leaf is mine to eat.
I stretch out and begin.
There are some sounds outside.

lines.zh: 火焰把叶子烤焦，也烤到我。
lines.en: Fire scorched the leaf and me with it.
I fell off the leaf.
Water pressed me flat to the leaf.
The whole leaf was flipped over.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过了叶子。
lines.en: Something sharp went through the leaf.
That light made me burn all over.

lines.zh: 这枝上已经没有叶子了。
lines.en: There are no leaves left on this branch.

lines.zh: 雷光把绿叶子照成白色。
lines.en: The flash turned the green leaves white.
I fell, and the leaf is gone.
